description: Read a business's email campaigns: its sending addresses and their setup readiness, recent campaigns with status, revision fingerprint and outcome counts, and the customers who can be emailed (recorded consent, not on the do-not-email list). Pass campaign_id for one campaign, or sender_id for the DNS records that sending address's domain needs. Read-only; any member of the business can read.

sender_id.description: Optional: that sender's domain setup records instead of the campaign view.

name: get_email_campaign
title: Get Email Campaign
